resources.string: Termux is not installed. Install it from F-Droid or Google Play.
For your security, Pipkin only runs in the official F-Droid or Google Play build of Termux, and the Termux on this phone is neither. Reinstall Termux from F-Droid or Google Play.
Pipkin isn\'t allowed to run commands in Termux. In Pipkin\'s app info, go to Permissions → Additional permissions → Run commands in Termux environment → Allow, then retry.
Termux blocked Pipkin\'s commands. Run the setup command in Termux, then retry.
Android blocked starting Termux in the background. Open Pipkin and retry.
Open Termux once and let it finish installing.
Node.js is missing in Termux. Run the setup command in Termux, then retry.
Node.js can\'t run or is too old. Run `%1$s` in Termux, then retry.
Pipkin\'s Termux helper did not receive its token. Retry.
Pipkin\'s Termux helper exited with status %1$d before connecting.
Termux did not respond in time. Open Termux once, then retry.
The connection to Termux closed unexpectedly. Retry.
Termux stopped while starting Pipkin\'s helper. Retry.
Termux couldn\'t run Pipkin\'s helper. Retry.
Termux was reinstalled, which removed Pi, its sign-in and Pipkin\'s setup in Termux. Run the setup command in Termux again.
Pipkin isn\'t set up in Termux yet. Run the setup command in Termux.
Termux\'s Pipkin helper doesn\'t recognize this Pipkin. Run the setup command in Termux again.
Pipkin\'s helper isn\'t running in Termux. Open Termux, then switch back to Pipkin.
Another app is using the ports Pipkin\'s helper needs. Restart your phone, then retry.
